items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: No, I remember his saying that he was taught by Professor Nicholson.

ctx.x: But, uh... Did he ever say if he ever started on any other instrument like guitar or...
No, I remember his saying that he was taught by Professor Nicholson. Oh, yeah. Nicholson or Nicholson. I think it's Nicholson. Nicholson. Nicholson.

There was a whole family of those. I know Professor Minetta talks about him. Yes. He studied. And, uh, Jellero Martin, the Ferdinand Martin studied with one of the, uh, Nicholson's too. They had a school. I've seen the ads of their school. They ran the little music school. Yeah.
